question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

Your doctor will recommend a treatment __based to the types__ of infection.
solution:
The correct answer is: **based on the type**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace "**based to**" with "**based on**" to correct the sentence.
 
• The preposition "**to**" is used to indicate a destination or direction.
 
 
• **Example -*** We're going to Liverpool next week.*
 
 
 
• The preposition "**on**" is used to use the information to support or prove an opinion or belief.
 
 
• **Example -*** We based our decision on the facts in the report.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, '**based on**' is the preferred choice. The usual preposition used with the verb base has been on or upon for a long time
 
 
• **Example -**
 
 
• *“based on the novel”*
 
• *“based upon their research”*
 
 
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Corrected sentence:** *Your doctor will recommend a treatment based on the types__ of infection. *
